# Robert Allen Bautista

> Plain-English tax tips for Kansas City and Lawrence freelancers, gig workers and small business owners. Robert Allen Bautista: M.S. in Accounting, former PwC, CPA candidate, author of The Small Business Tax Code, Unlocked and The Small Business Tax Calendar. As quoted in Homes.com and Stonebridge Herald.
